Profit Before Tax derived as Net Profit plus Income Tax; Gross Profit as Revenue minus Cost of Sales. Cross checked: Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit and Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit. Filled 2026-10-01 from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income API: Income Tax FY2024 from the source line Tax Charge; Income Tax FY2025 from the source line Tax Charge. | CRON 20261001: EPS row added from the audited FY2025 results (year ended 31 Dec 2025): basic EPS KES 3.45, FY2024 2.36; ties to the stored Net Profit 2,170,880,000 against Profit Before Tax 3,867,060,000 less Income Tax 1,696,180,000 | CRON 20261002: revenue restated to the printed net revenue base (revenue from contracts with customers less indirect taxes and duties) so the printed gross profit and the published gross margin tie; gross profit, operating profit and the three margins corrected off that base.
